title: Error messages

byCode.validation_failed: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
byCode.bot_check_failed: We couldn't confirm you're a person. Refresh the page and try again.
byCode.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
byCode.not_found: We can't find what you're looking for. Check the link and try again.
byCode.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
byCode.email_disposable: Please use a real email address.
byCode.email_domain_not_found: We can't find that email domain. Check for typos.
byCode.email_taken: That email already has an account.
byCode.not_signed_in: You're not logged in. Log in to carry on.
byCode.origin_not_allowed: We couldn't send that from this page. Refresh the page and try again.
byCode.guest_session_invalid: This scan has expired or can't be found. Please upload your CV again.
byCode.reset_token_invalid: This link has expired. Request a new one.
byCode.google_not_configured: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use your email and password instead.
byCode.google_pending_invalid: Your Google sign-in has timed out. Continue with Google again.

network: We couldn't reach Gradea. Check your connection and try again.
